what: Hides the system cursor, and an accent-color crosshair (two 4×16px bars) follows the mouse exactly with no lag. Over a card or row that has a label (data-label), an accent pill (text + right arrow) appears right at the crosshair position, expanding from width and height 0 to full size in .2s (site-builder easeOut — measured on the original, opacity is 1 immediately). On leaving, width, height and opacity collapse over the same duration. data-icon="play" No text, just a play triangle in a 40px circle

options.[data-fx-part=target]: Child where the pill expands — its text is the data-label, data-icon="play" Surface play circle
options.follow: Follow-through delay (seconds), default 0 (Webflow smoothing 0) — if set, it lags with power3

note: On touch devices (no hover) it doesn’t attach and the system cursor stays as is. Only one cross and pill is made on body, shared by several panels on the same page

from.where: shared.js cursor (original cursor-wrapper · cursor-line · cursor-dynamic-wrapper.open/.read-case/.play — IX2 a-47 mouse follow smoothing 0, a-50~57 expand .2s easeOut)
